items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-08-28
items.q: a guy named Kilinski a violin teacher on St. Charles did some recording

ctx.x: I was trying to remember the name and I can't recall and then some years later a guy named Kilinski a violin teacher on St. Charles did some recording and mainly he had a little disc machine and mainly for his students but he did things if somebody wanted to come in and record he did recordings but it was mainly for his students you've got to remember the technology was miserable back then you're talking about recording direct to acetate discs and even the finished product wasn't that great if you managed to get…
right so that was that was it that was it
